author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿದಿರೆಯೆಂಬುವದೊಂದು ದೇವದಾನವ ಶಕುತಿ
ಎದುರುನಿಲ್ಲುವ ಜನರ ಮಣಿಸದೆಯೆ ಬಿಡದು
ಮಧುರ ನಶೆಯತಿಯಾಗೆ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ನಶಿಸುವುದು
ಹೆದರದೆಯೆ ಎದುರಿಸದ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Sleep is a power both divine and demonic;
it will not spare those who stand against it without bending them;
when its sweet intoxication is too much, activity perishes;
face it without fear, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Sleep restores us but can also overpower us. Too much of its sweet intoxication kills initiative. Master it rather than being mastered.
